decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range fits the firm's core safety footwear business, costs little to keep in the catalogue, and the missing archive data for 2020-2021 gives no evidence that its value has failed, so the option stays open.

ESD occupational shoes serve steady industrial demand, share production with the firm's existing lines, and nothing reported shows the product is unlikely to pay off, so keeping it is the cheaper choice.
As a general safety shoe series it is central to the firm's portfolio, and without negative evidence the low carrying cost favours holding the option rather than abandoning it.
